A vulnerability in Apache Jena Fuseki in the SHACL validation functionality cause server side request forgery (SSRF).



This issue affects Apache Jena Fuseki: through 6.2.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes the issue.
Failure to sanitize special elements into a different plane (special element injection) in Azure App Service allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in the application/vnd.hex+erlang request body parser in hexpm hexpm allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute operating system commands via a crafted Erlang external term format request body. This vulnerability was actively exploited against the hex.pm service on 2026-11-23.

HexpmWeb.ErlangFormat.decode/1 in lib/hexpm_web/erlang_format.ex decodes the body with Plug.Crypto.non_executable_binary_to_term/2, which accepts maps that have a __struct__ key. HexpmWeb.PlugParser.parse/5 returns the decoded term as the request params. The parser runs in the endpoint before routing and authentication, so a POST to any route reaches it. Elixir dispatches protocols on the __struct__ key, so the client selects which Inspect and Enumerable implementations run when error reporting inspects the params. A chain through Ecto.Query.DynamicExpr and DBConnection.Stream reaches an apply/3 call on a {module, function, args} tuple taken from the request body.

This issue affects hex.pm: from 2016-02-23 before 2026-11-23; hexpm/hexpm: from ab1bbcef7cc8395d1056d3b1aa6a174353492d59 before 379b0a29bcc95164249f38ad7d772a37a8ff9533.

TypesenseVectorStore is vulnerable to a document ID injection in its delete operation that can cause unintended documents to be deleted.



 TypesenseVectorStore.doDelete(List<String>) builds a Typesense filter_by expression by raw string concatenation of caller-supplied document IDs into the form id: [id1,id2,...] . The Typesense id field uses bare (unquoted) values in this list form with no escaping mechanism. An ID containing characters with syntactic meaning in the Typesense filter grammar — such as a comma ( , ), a closing bracket ( ] ), or operator tokens ( || , && ) — can break out of the list literal and alter the structure of the filter expression.



 An attacker who controls a document ID passed to the delete operation can use this to delete documents other than the intended ones (comma injection), or to construct a filter that matches every document in the collection (operator breakout), resulting in unintended bulk deletion.



 Applications that pass externally supplied or user-controlled document IDs to VectorStore.delete(List<String>) backed by TypesenseVectorStore are affected.
Any connected WiFi client can fetch device info and meeting recording metadata without credentials.

Web administration panel (port 8080) binds to all network interfaces including public IPv6 addresses, making internal API endpoints reachable over WAN without firewall protection (related to CVE-2026-50224).
Endpoints accessible without authentication from any WiFi client (e.g., /user/hasSimCard, /user/pooling, /api/device-info).
Any WiFi client can send HTTP DELETE to /meeting-recording/delete to permanently delete files without authentication.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.26 through 0.7.4, AutoGPT Platform ships a publicly known, hardcoded default JWT verification key in backend/.env.default and autogpt_platform/.env.default. Because HS256 is symmetric, anyone who knows the secret can forge valid JWTs for any user or for the admin role, bypassing authentication and authorization without user interaction. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.
Improper authentication in Azure Event Grid allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK A7100RU 7.4cu.2313_B20191024. This issue affects the function exportOvpn of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component CGI Handler. This manipulation of the argument Username causes os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely.

Unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in Tegsoft Yönetim ve Bilişim Hizmetleri Tic. Ltd. Şti. Tegsoft Contact Center allows Upload a Web Shell to a Web Server.

This issue affects Tegsoft Contact Center: before latest-202611161510.

A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864.

Miren Runtime provides the runtime component for the Miren application platform. Prior to 0.11.1, the QUIC/HTTP3 RPC server on the default port 8443 uses tls.RequestClientCert and does not verify that presented certificates chain to the configured cluster certificate authority. The RPC authenticators derive a caller identity from PeerCertificates[0].Subject.CommonName without requiring a non-empty VerifiedChains value, and certificate identities bypass all RBAC checks. A network attacker who can reach the listener can present a self-signed certificate with an issuer distinguished name matching the public cluster CA subject and gain cluster superuser access, allowing disclosure, modification, or disruption of applications, sandboxes, disks, credentials, and other managed resources. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.1.

cf-manager is an all-in-one dashboard for managing multiple Cloudflare accounts and services. Prior to 1.1.2, worker/src/routes/workers.ts uses bare fetch(url) calls to retrieve user-supplied URLs and deploys the returned content as a Worker script using stored Cloudflare credentials. The multipart and JSON branches of POST /api/:accountId/workers and POST /api/batch-deploy accept URLs without protocol, destination, redirect, content-type, or response-size validation. An attacker with deployment API access, or unauthenticated access when API_SECRET is not configured, can make cf-manager access internal resources or fetch attacker-controlled JavaScript and execute it in the victim Cloudflare Workers account. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.2.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.

Vulnerabilities in the PAPI protocol of AOS-10 could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to circumvent existing authentication controls. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to gain administrative access, modify system configurations, and access or manipulate sensitive data.

Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to gain administrative privileges via a forged authentication token.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

OS command injection in the a3cli restricted shell in Lantronix S2220 Series 2 allows an authenticated attacker to bypass shell restrictions and execute arbitrary operating system commands via unsanitized command substitution metacharacters, including backticks and $(), in parameters of permitted commands over SSH. This vulnerability is fixed in firmware version 1.3.37.
Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.
Improper authorization in M365 Copilot allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Argument Injection vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and unauthorized access to filesystem resources.

Flowintel disabled TLS certificate verification for all MISP API connections and used unverified SSL contexts for IMAP and SMTP STARTTLS mail connections. This allowed an on-path (man-in-the-middle) attacker positioned between Flowintel and its MISP or mail servers to impersonate the remote server and intercept sensitive data.

Affected connections include:
- All MISP HTTPS API calls (event retrieval, attribute search, event creation, connectivity checks, and API validation)
- SMTP STARTTLS connections used for sending email notifications
- IMAP TLS connections used for fetching mail archives and testing connectivity

An attacker who can observe or intercept network traffic between Flowintel and the MISP or mail server could:
- Capture MISP API keys and mail credentials (SMTP/IMAP passwords)
- Read all threat intelligence data exchanged (events, attributes, objects, reports)
- Inject or modify threat intelligence data returned to Flowintel

The vulnerability required no authentication on the part of the attacker and no user interaction; it was exploitable by any party with a network position between Flowintel and its configured MISP or mail endpoints.

Affected versions: Flowintel prior to 4.1.0.

The
Danfoss legacy AK-SC 355 and AK-SM 800 Series are vulnerable to unauthorized
access when default credentials or known passwords are used for authentication.
These products were manufactured with default credentials documented in the
product manual. All versions are affected.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the Apps edit, Containers edit, and Playbooks execute permissions could use the App Wizard to execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR. This could compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the Splunk SOAR instance.
The vulnerability exists because the App Wizard does not validate user-supplied identifiers before incorporating them into generated connector code.

A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability found in UniFi Access Application to execute arbitrary commands on certain adopted UniFi Access devices.

A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability found in UniFi Access Application to escalate privileges within UniFi OS.

A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit a series of authenticated SQL Injection vulnerabilities found in UniFi Access Application to escalate privileges on the host device.

A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit an Improper Link Resolution Before File Access vulnerability found in UniFi Access Application to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the host device.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the backup prefix field is only checked for a nonempty value, and normalizeS3Path preserves shell metacharacters before the prefix is interpolated into rclone upload and retention-cleanup command strings. An authenticated organization member with backup permission for a service can execute arbitrary commands as root on the Dokploy host or configured remote server when a PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, libSQL, Compose, or web-server backup runs manually, on schedule, or performs retention cleanup. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the Nixpacks publishDirectory build setting accepts shell metacharacters and is interpolated into a docker cp command executed through child_process.exec. An authenticated user with access to an application can execute arbitrary commands on the Dokploy host when triggering a Nixpacks deployment, leading to host compromise through the privileged Docker environment. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, mount.deleteFileMount passes a path containing the user-controlled filePath to the local removeFileOrDirectory helper, which interpolates it unquoted into rm -rf, while the remote branch is quoted. An authenticated member with file-mount create and delete permissions can execute arbitrary commands in the host context immediately when deleting a local file mount, without requiring a running container. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). From 0.29.13 until 0.31.0, the Docker terminal, container-log, and monitoring WebSocket handlers accept a caller-controlled serviceId as authorization but do not consistently bind the requested containerId or appName to that service. A member with read access to any service can consequently target unrelated containers, obtain a root shell in the Dokploy panel container, read other tenants' logs and statistics, and use the mounted Docker socket to compromise the host. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.0.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the database password validation used by the MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and Redis change-password procedures permits backticks, and the procedures interpolate attacker-controlled passwords into Bash command strings. An authenticated user who can update a database password can trigger command substitution before the database command runs, resulting in arbitrary operating-system command execution with the Dokploy process privileges, which are typically root. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via build attribute injection

VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service.
Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5).
Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116).

kev_info.vulnerabilityName: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
kev_info.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Security Center, including external identity providers using OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0, and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) using WS-Trust or WS-Federation.
Under specific conditions, successful exploitation may allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the system with the privileges of an affected user. Successful exploitation requires a specific combination of conditions to be met, which reduces the likelihood of a successful attack.
Double free in Microsoft Office Visio allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

Bytebase DBHub MCP Incorrect Authorization Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Bytebase DBHub. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the MCP server. The issue results from an incorrect authorization decision when parsing untrusted SQL. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-27635.

Super Magic PHPSandbox Command Injection Sandbox Escape Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass the sandbox on affected installations of Super Magic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the PHPSandbox endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute PHP code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escape the sandbox and execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-28102.

PyTables is a Python package to manage extremely large amounts of data. In 3.11.1 and earlier, tables/attributeset.py treats a NumPy bytes scalar ending in a period as a pickled Python object and calls pickle.loads() when the attribute is accessed through AttributeSet.__getattr__ or AttributeSet.__getitem__. Opening an attacker-controlled HDF5 file and reading an affected metadata attribute can execute attacker-controlled code in the consumer’s process. No fixed version is available as of this review.

Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows SQL Injection.

This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.3 before v14.08.5.

Several plugins for WordPress published by WP connect (Orders Sync to Airtable for WooCommerce, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Notion, WP Sync for Notion – Notion to WordPress, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Airtable, Add-on Brevo for Gravity Forms, and Air WP Sync – Airtable to WordPress) contain embedded malicious code (a backdoor) in the versions listed. The affected releases unconditionally load a backdoor module (includes/airwp-online.php) that runs on every request via the 'init' hook and on a half-hourly WP-Cron event, sends site information (site URL, PHP, WordPress and OS versions, and the server user) to a remote command-and-control server at tascredit-pay.com with TLS certificate verification disabled, and executes the PHP code returned by that server via eval(). The module also accepts queued commands that run shell commands, read, write and delete arbitrary files, query arbitrary database tables, dump the users table including password hashes, drop a webshell into the uploads directory, and install persistent hourly code execution. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers in control of the remote server, or able to intercept its traffic, to execute arbitrary code on the server and fully compromise affected sites. All affected plugins have been closed on WordPress.org and no patched versions are available; we strongly recommend uninstalling them and running a complete malware scan.

In NotifyCachedPeers of low_energy_scanner.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a scan result cache being cleared while it is being iterated. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In EnhancedRetransmissionModeRxEngine::ProcessPdu of enhanced_retransmission_mode_rx_engine.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a connection failure callback that synchronously destroys the channel and its engines while a received frame is still being processed. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In IsBrEdrCrossTransportKeyDerivationAllowed of security_manager.cc, there is a possible way to replace an authenticated LE long term key with an unauthenticated one due to a logic error in the key strength check. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In StartDescriptorDiscovery of remote_service.cc, there is a possible use after free due to the service object being destroyed from within a synchronous callback while it is still iterating over its characteristics. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In BrEdrSignalingChannel::DecodeRxUnit of bredr_signaling_channel.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a missing object lifetime check in a command processing loop. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In OnEncryptionChange of security_manager.cc, there is a possible way to establish a bond marked as authenticated without completing authenticated pairing due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In LogicalLink::SignalError of logical_link.cc, there is a possible use after free due to the object being destroyed by a callback while it is still iterating over its channels. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In ResolvePendingNotifyRequests of remote_characteristic.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a status callback that can destroy the object while its pending request queue is still being iterated. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated /rest/v0/users/me/authentication_tokens route then returns reusable login token IDs. This vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.9.2 and 6.10.1.

An improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability in the OAuth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.1.1-42962-10, 7.2.1-69057-14, 7.2.2-72806-11, 7.3.2-86009-6, and 7.4.1-90080-2 allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in mra13 / Team Tips and Tricks HQ Simple Shopping Cart wordpress-simple-paypal-shopping-cart allows Object Injection.This issue affects Simple Shopping Cart: from n/a through 5.3.3.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Pierre Lannoy APCu Manager apcu-manager allows Object Injection.This issue affects APCu Manager: from n/a through 4.6.1.

The Nexter Blocks Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.10 via the `tpgb_ajax_register_user()` function. This is due to a byte-level denylist on the `tpgb_acf_key[]` and `tpgb_acf[]` parameters that fails to block Unicode look-alike characters — such as U+1E87 and U+00E7 in a key like `ẇp_çapabilities` — whose UTF-8 byte sequences do not match any ASCII-based pattern check, while the database's default accent-insensitive collation (`utf8mb4_unicode_ci` / `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci`) treats the decorated key as equivalent to the canonical `wp_capabilities` row, causing `update_user_meta()` to overwrite the newly registered user's role with `administrator`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to register a new account bearing the full Administrator role, gaining complete control over the WordPress site including the ability to install plugins, modify files, and execute arbitrary code. The nonce required by the handler is publicly emitted on any page containing the tp-login-register block, making the full exploit chain — nonce retrieval, a single crafted registration POST, and the plugin's own `autologin` flow — trivially reachable on any default install where user registration is enabled. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.

The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This is due to the plugin splicing the attacker-controlled request URI into a PHP expression inside a double-quoted string and evaluating it with eval(). Because PHP interpolates double-quoted strings, a payload of the form {${...}} in the URL path is executed during interpolation, so no quote breakout is required and WordPress' slashing does not mitigate it. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server with a single GET request. The affected conditions ship enabled by default and are evaluated before any logged-in check, so no plugin configuration is needed; the site must have BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro active alongside this plugin.
An out-of-bounds write issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination.

monailabel (aka MONAI Label) before 0.8.6 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint, as exploited in the wild starting in September 2026.

kev_info.vulnerabilityName: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev_info.shortDescription: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

items.description: The BuddyBoss Addons plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in versions up to, and including, 1.2.1. This is due to the Social Login REST endpoint trusting unverified Apple and Facebook identity-token claims and linking an attacker-controlled provider identifier to an existing WordPress user selected by the token’s email claim. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers who know a user’s email address to associate their provider identity with that account, including administrator accounts, and subsequently authenticate as the victim. Successful exploitation requires the BuddyBoss Platform plugin to be installed and active, with the Social Login module and selected provider enabled and configured. On sites with the separate BuddyBoss App JWT component, the vulnerable REST request can return an application token immediately.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Tribulant Software Newsletters newsletters-lite allows Object Injection.This issue affects Newsletters: from n/a through 4.18.2.

Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability in miniOrange miniorange otp verification miniorange-otp-verification allows Authentication Abuse.This issue affects miniorange otp verification: from n/a through 5.6.1.
Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Paul Ryan Authorizer authorizer allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Authorizer: from n/a before 3.17.2.

The User Registration Aide WordPress plugin through 1.5.3.8 does not verify the current password or a reset token before changing a user's password, allowing unauthenticated attackers who know a user's username and email address to change the password of any account, including administrators, and take it over.

Key exchange without entity authentication vulnerability in Apache Tomcat allowed an unauthenticated node to join a cluster when the cluster was secured with TLS 1.3 and TLS-PSK.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: 11.0.28-11.0.29, 10.1.62, 9.0.124.



Users are recommended to switch to TLS 1.2 and TLS-PSK or upgrade to version 11.0.30, 10.1.63 or 9.0.125 (when released), which fix the issue.

Etherpad is a real-time collaborative editor. From 1.8.14 until 3.3.3, the pre-authentication /static/* plugin asset handler in src/node/utils/Minify.ts performs a backslash-to-forward-slash conversion after src/node/utils/sanitizePathname.ts has completed its POSIX path checks. On POSIX systems the sanitizer correctly treats backslashes as ordinary filename bytes, but the later conversion turns encoded backslash-separated parent-directory segments into traversal components without revalidation or containment. The expressPreSession registration and the always-present ep_etherpad-lite core pseudo-plugin make this path reachable without credentials, allowing a remote attacker to read any file available to the Etherpad process. Disclosed configuration or environment secrets can expose administrator credentials, after which the administrator plugin installer can provide in-process code execution and full server compromise. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.3.

IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to SQL injection in the edge-controller component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access or modify sensitive database information.

IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to insecure deserialization in the SharePoint Tap MulticastTransceiver component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.10.3 until 3.10.4, the NLTK 3.10.3 JVM hardening validates Java launcher tokens in the options channel but appends the caller-controlled cmd sequence without requiring its first token to be a main class. Supplying -jar or an @argfile through nltk.internals.java or StanfordSegmenter.java_class can therefore execute attacker-selected Java bytecode without the unsafe-JAR opt-in. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service or potential code execution on the NAS node.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to read, modify, or delete arbitrary files on the NAS node.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 remote code execution was possible via external pull requests

The WP Duplicate – WordPress Migration Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.11 via the save_single_batch_file function. This is due to a PHP type-juggling authentication bypass via loose != comparison with no is_string() guard, combined with unsanitized base64-decoded path construction in save_single_batch_file() lacking any directory traversal containment. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to execute code on the server. Exploitation requires that the site owner has completed the plugin's initial setup so that the site_type and prod_key_random_id options are non-empty, though any non-empty secret value is bypassable via the type-juggling flaw.

AnsibleForms is a self-hosted web application that turns automation into self-service forms. Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms uses a public hard-coded fallback JWT signing secret from server/config/auth.config.js when ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET is unset. An unauthenticated attacker can sign a self-contained token with privileged claims because server/src/auth/auth_jwt.js verifies the signature without reloading the user from the database, and server/src/lib/middleware.js trusts the token's roles and options for authorization. A forged token can therefore be accepted as an administrator session, resulting in authentication bypass and full privileged API access. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.1.
temporary redacted

Dialoqbase is an application for creating chatbots. Prior to 1.11.5, the unauthenticated GET /api/v1/view/* route in server/src/routes/api/v1/view/root.ts resolves its attacker-controlled wildcard path without normalization or containment, allowing traversal outside the intended uploads directory and arbitrary server file reads. Reading environment files can disclose DB_SECRET_KEY, the application’s JWT signing key, which permits forged administrator tokens and takeover of bots, conversations, integrations, and stored third-party credentials. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.5.

The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 via deserialization of untrusted input in the course importer. The set_post_metas() method  calls maybe_unserialize() on attacker-controlled postmeta string values parsed from the uploaded JSON import file. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP Objects. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that the site has enable_instructor_registration=true AND enable_guest_checkout=true AND at least one purchasable course exists. Install.php sets enable_instructor_registration=false on fresh installs, so this is a non-default configuration. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a stack-based buffer overflow in the NAS TFTP service that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service or potential code execution.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds memory vulnerability in the NAS NFS service that an unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit to cause a denial of service.

The Trust Payments Gateway for WooCommerce (JavaScript Library) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.8. The vulnerability exists because the `new_customer_account()` function stores the raw return value of `wp_create_user()` — including a `WP_Error` object returned on username collision — into the order's `tp_userid` post meta before the `is_wp_error()` guard is evaluated; the `add_customer_details_to_thankyou_page()` callback subsequently reads that meta and casts it with `(int)`, causing PHP to coerce any object to integer `1`, after which `wp_set_current_user(1)` and `wp_set_auth_cookie(1)` are called unconditionally. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as WordPress user ID 1 — the bootstrap site administrator or, on multisite, a network super-admin — by supplying the `new_username` parameter matching any existing login during checkout and visiting the resulting thank-you page. Exploitation requires the Trust Payments gateway to be active and the attacker to complete a paid order on their own account; the ID 1 administrator username is additionally enumerable via standard WordPress user enumeration techniques.

The Unzer Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.1. The vulnerability exists because the Google Pay Express Checkout endpoint (`/?wc-api=google_pay_express`), handled by `startCheckoutDataWithNormalizedCustomerData`, accepts an attacker-controlled `paymentData.email` value and passes it to `createOrGetGuestCustomer()`, which resolves the submitted email to any existing WordPress user via `get_user_by('email', ...)` and then calls `wp_set_current_user()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()` for the resolved user ID without verifying ownership of the email address, a password, a nonce, an authentication token, or any proof of payment from the payment provider. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in as any existing WordPress user — including administrators — by submitting that user's known email address, receiving valid `wordpress_logged_in_*` session cookies for the targeted account and achieving full site takeover. The endpoint is entirely unprotected with no capability check, nonce validation, or payment-provider signature verification applied, and administrator email addresses are frequently discoverable via the WordPress REST API user enumeration endpoint (`/wp-json/wp/v2/users`), author archive pages, Gravatar lookups, or site contact footers.

Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads. The server read a nonzero expiry as 2^32 times the requested value. A token created through the Go TCP client therefore stayed valid about four billion times longer than the caller asked for.

This issue affects Apache Iggy Go SDK: from 0.5.0 before 0.10.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Tokens that an earlier version created keep their long expiry on the server. Delete those tokens and create new ones.

In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames. `net__read_ws()` in `lib/net_ws.c` returns the number of framing bytes consumed (the 4 masking-key bytes) for a data frame with a zero-length payload, without writing any bytes to the caller’s buffer. The MQTT packet reader in `packet__read_single()` (`lib/packet_mosq.c`) trusts that return value as a payload byte count. A remote client can therefore advance the read position over an uninitialised heap allocation, causing the broker to process and forward uninitialised heap memory (information disclosure, including heap and libc pointers), and can underflow the unsigned `to_process` counter so that subsequent attacker-controlled frame data is written past the end of the allocation (heap out-of-bounds write). The out-of-bounds write is reachable from the CONNECT packet before any authentication check, so an unauthenticated client can corrupt the heap and crash the broker even when `allow_anonymous false` is set. Combining the disclosure and the write allows remote code execution as the broker’s user by any client able to establish a session.

In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.0.0 to 2.0.22 and 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, the return value of password hash functions for sha512-pbkdf2 and legacy sha512 were not checked. Starting with OpenSSL 4.0, sha512-pbkdf2 hashing will fail when using the FIPS provider for passwords shorter than 8 characters. This has the effect that newly created passwords would match against any other password with fewer than 8 characters.

Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport. A self-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) identified the user only by numeric user ID, and a new user takes the lowest free ID. After an administrator deleted a user, that user's unexpired token, or a token refreshed from it while the ID was free, authenticated as the next account created with that ID and had that account's permissions. Only deployments with HTTP enabled are affected.

This issue affects Apache Iggy: through 0.9.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.

Improper Authentication in Apache SeaTunnel Web 1.0.2 allows a user whose account has been disabled to authenticate with valid credentials and obtain a new login token. The login query does not check the account status, so disabling an account does not prevent new logins or access to protected APIs using the newly issued token. This issue requires valid credentials for the disabled account; it is not a credential-free authentication bypass.



Apache SeaTunnel Web is no longer maintained. The affected 1.0.2 release does not contain the account-status check added to the main branch in pull request #264. There is no maintained fixed release. Users should discontinue use of this unsupported component.



NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

The Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3 does not validate the real type of files uploaded through its public form, trusting the client-declared MIME type instead, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to upload PHP files to a public directory and execute them before they are deleted, on servers that do not honour the Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3's Apache-only access restriction.

The Flamix: Bitrix24 and WooCommerce Products Sync WordPress plugin before 1.7.0 does not restrict or validate an unauthenticated file-exchange request, allowing anyone to write a file with an attacker-chosen name, extension and path to a web-served location and thereby execute arbitrary PHP.

Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive data or functionality. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.
Sandbox escape due to use-after-free in the DOM: Navigation component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8.
Sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: WebRender component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8.

Sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Networking: HTTP component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 115.46, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8.
