Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Azure Portal allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
Server-side request forgery in Azure Machine Learning allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
Server-side request forgery in Profile Data Roaming Service (PDRS) allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution. This vulnerability is considered critical as it may allow unauthenticated command execution.

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Playbooks view, edit, execute, and delete permissions could cause existing cross-repository playbook references to run attacker-controlled playbook code.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR can bind existing cross-repository playbook references to a different source control repository when a deleted repository name is reused.

Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. From 0.11.4 until 0.12.30, the generic GET /yjs/:documentName WebSocket route in InitializeYjsResources requires a session but does not authorize the database resource selected by a typename.referenceId.columnName room name. The YJS initial-content provider then reads the selected file.* column without CanRead or CanUpdate checks, and bidirectional synchronization allows a low-privileged authenticated user to read or modify restricted row content. Unauthenticated requests are rejected, and standalone non-canonical room names remain shared-by-name rooms. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.30.

A command injection vulnerability was found in OpenStack Cinder's SSH-based storage-driver support. Incomplete validation of shell metacharacters allows an authenticated user who owns a volume on an affected backend to supply crafted connection information and inject additional commands into the storage array's management interface. Commands execute with the privileges of Cinder's configured backend account. This can disclose storage configuration information and, where that account has administrative permissions, could allow changes that affect the integrity or availability of other tenants' storage.

Wavelog is web-based amateur radio logging software. Prior to 2.5, the filename parameter accepted by POST /qsl/addQsoToQsl in application/controllers/Qsl.php addQsoToQsl() is stored without rejecting directory separators or relative path components, and POST /qsl/delete reaches application/models/Qsl_model.php deleteQsl(), which passes the planted qsl_images filename to unlink(). A standard authenticated user can associate the malicious filename with the user's own QSO, satisfy the ownership check, escape the per-user QSL image directory, and delete files writable by the PHP worker. Deleting configuration or operational files can cause denial of service, while deleting installer gate files can reopen the unauthenticated installer and enable application identity takeover through attacker-controlled database configuration. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the storage-processor interconnect driver that could allow a malicious peer to execute code with system privileges.

Thymeleaf before 3.1.6.RELEASE contains a restricted expression mode bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to perform forbidden actions through improperly scoped expression objects. Attackers can inject input into restricted contexts like preprocessing, th:utext, th:on* handlers, fragment names, or TEXT templates to escalate server-side template injection.

LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in its e-mail-based Helpdesk ticket intake. The mail parser does not reject Apache .htaccess configuration files or PHP-executable files when saving ticket attachments. A remote unauthenticated attacker can e-mail a Helpdesk ticket with such an attachment; in the default configuration, anyone can request the uploaded file's URL which executes attacker-supplied code with the privileges of the web server process. No operator interaction or LMS client session is required.


The issue was fixed in commit d5059b1.

A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0)  allows attacker-controlled HTML in a backend response to exploit the Smart Form Protection feature, possibly leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or Remote Code Execution (RCE) attack against the Airlock Gateway. The issue has been fixed in Airlock Gateway version 8.5.3 and 8.6.1.

For an attack to be executable, the Airlock Gateway needs to have 'Smart Form Protection' (or the corresponding expert settings) enabled on a mapping whose backend returns a response containing certain multi-byte HTML character references. The buffer overflow then happens during the parsing of that HTML response. Such a response can come either from a malicious or compromised backend, or from an otherwise trusted backend that returns attacker-supplied HTML, e.g. an application that stores and serves plain user-provided HTML files.

Successfully exploiting the vulnerability can enable an attacker to perform a DoS attack or, in the worst case, an RCE attack against the Airlock Gateway in front of the affected backend. Compromising the functionality of the Airlock Gateway could in this way also affect the availability and protection of other well-intentioned backends deployed behind the same Gateway.

Joomla! Core - [20261156] - Core - RCE through media custom field parameters in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Inadequate escaping of media field parameters in the generated form XML allowed manipulating the form definition, leading to a remote code execution vulnerability.

compose-farm 0.19.0 before 1.22.0 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking and cross-site request forgery vulnerability because its unauthenticated web UI performs no Origin validation. Malicious websites visited by users can open /ws/shell/{host} or /ws/exec sockets, or abuse unquoted service parameters and PUT /api/console/file, to execute commands on all managed hosts.

Improper verification of a cryptographic signature in the PSP Boot ROM of AMD Zeppelin (Zen1/Zen+) processors could allow an attacker with local access to the SPI flash to bypass secure boot authentication, potentially resulting in arbitrary unsigned code execution at full Platform Security Processor privilege, loss of confidentiality, loss of integrity of the host boot chain, and persistent loss of availability.

In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), several SECURITY DEFINER functions in the pem schema of the PEM backend database are owned by a superuser but do not set a safe search_path. Any PEM user who can connect to the PEM backend database can create objects that these functions use in place of the intended ones, and so run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges. Temporary objects can be used for this on every supported PostgreSQL version, and objects in the public schema on PostgreSQL 14 backends and backends upgraded from PostgreSQL 14.
From PEM 10.6.1, these functions run with a fixed search_path.

In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the row-level security policies on pem.job and pem.jobstep that apply to PEM agents do not limit an agent to its own jobs. An attacker who controls one monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can create, change or delete jobs for every other agent, including the agent on the PEM server. Agents run SQL job steps with the database credentials of the server they monitor, and shell job steps where batch jobs are enabled, so compromising one monitored host can give superuser SQL access to every monitored database and to the PEM backend.
From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents can no longer create jobs or change job definitions or job steps.

In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem_agent role, which every PEM agent login inherits, is a member of the PostgreSQL pg_read_server_files and pg_write_server_files roles on the PEM backend database. An attacker who controls any monitored host, and so its PEM agent certificate, can read and write files on the PEM server host as the postgres operating system user. This includes the PEM certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certificates for other agents and act as them.
From PEM 10.6.1, PEM agents no longer hold these roles.

Authorization bypass in the publication of XOneManager 3.8.3.0 updates. During testing, the server accepted initial requests from an authenticated project member with read-only access without verifying publication permissions. If the workflow is completed, updates with modified content could be distributed to managed devices.

Authorization bypass in the ‘tablesData’ operation of the POST request to ‘/xmanagercore/api/services/’ in XOneManager 3.8.3.0. An authenticated project member can execute SQL queries using ‘filter’ without the server verifying their execution permissions. The queries use the service account’s permissions. During testing, databases outside the project were queried, including the authentication database.

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could use an empty clustering shared secret to read and modify clustering configuration through the cluster configuration Representational State Transfer (REST) API endpoint on a standalone instance. This could expose clustering configuration, persist attacker-controlled clustering settings, and disrupt clustering operations.
The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise accepts the empty clustering shared secret as a shared-authentication candidate on a standalone instance when clustering is turned off.

Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. Prior to 0.12.30, the generic GET /api/{entity} list endpoint accepts attacker-controlled sort values in PaginatedFindAllWithoutFilters in server/resource/resource_findallpaginated.go without validating the requested column against the table schema. The code uses those values for SELECT and ORDER BY identifier construction, so an embedded identifier quote can terminate the quoted identifier and make the remainder parse as SQL, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to extract unauthorized table data through blind or error-based behavior or repeatedly trigger query failures. This issue is fixed in version 0.12.30.

Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Code injection via calculation formulas in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Calculation field formulas were executed using PHP eval() without validating their content, allowing backend users with field edit permissions to execute arbitrary PHP code.

Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Arbitrary file write leading to remote code execution in CSS editor in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.3, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The CSS editor did not restrict file names, extensions and paths of created and saved files, allowing privileged backend users to write arbitrary PHP files.

A vulnerability was found in GearUP Hyperev up to 20261020. This impacts the function get_wlan_sitesurvey of the file ld/utils.lua of the component WLAN Site Survey. Performing a manipulation of the argument line results in os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Wavelog is web-based amateur radio logging software. Prior to 2.5, the callsign parameter accepted by POST /oqrs/search_log in application/controllers/Oqrs.php search_log() reaches application/models/Oqrs_model.php search_log(), where it is concatenated directly into a raw SQL WHERE clause without parameter binding. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use UNION-based SQL injection to read arbitrary application database records, including account data, password hashes, API keys, station credentials, reset tokens, QSO data, and station metadata. Disclosure of password reset tokens can be combined with the forgot_password workflow to take over accounts, including administrator accounts. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows users who can launch instances from controlled images to inject LXC directives by embedding line breaks in OCI config.json values or oci.entrypoint and oci.cwd keys. Attackers can add liblxc hooks or crafted tmpfs lxc.mount.entry fields to run commands as root on the host or bind-mount host paths, even from restricted projects.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted clients to create and access default project resources by exploiting entitlement checks against the requested project. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq directives to execute code as root on the host, or manipulate inherited resources via the ?project= parameter.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories by supplying unvalidated dependent volume and snapshot names in the migration offer header. Attackers controlling a migration source can create root-owned volumes with attacker content at arbitrary host paths, compromising hosts using dir storage pools, bypassing restricted.storage-pools.access, or crashing the daemon.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted project users to create resources in the unrestricted default project by targeting projects lacking features.* flags. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq dhcp-script injection to run scripts as root, or custom volumes with block.create_options mkfs arguments to read host files.

Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SAML SSO callback that looks up sessions using unvalidated client-supplied identifiers. Users able to run live queries or enroll secret holders can plant attacker-controlled identity provider metadata in the session store, then present a self-signed SAML response to log in as a global admin.

Bazarr is a companion application to Sonarr and Radarr. Prior to 1.6.3-beta.11, the /api/subtitles/subtitles-info handler uses SubtitleNameContents.get() in subtitles_contents.py and reads the caller-supplied subtitlePath after checking only its subtitle extension; because the resolved path is not confined to files indexed by Bazarr, traversal can read files outside the media library. The /api/subtitles/subtitles handler in subtitles.py passes caller-supplied path and reference to sync and translation without per-path authorization, allowing an out-of-library reference file to be read and output to overwrite a file outside the media library. The authenticate decorator gates both endpoints when API authentication is enabled, while auth = None allows access without credentials. Both paths can affect only files that the Bazarr process can read or write. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.3-beta.11.

LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to privilege escalation in the lmsd daemon. The daemon loads the libraries listed in the LMS database without checking that they come from a trusted location. An attacker with access to the web server process or with write access to the LMS database can register a malicious library and trigger a configuration reload, causing lmsd to load and execute it. Because the example systemd unit does not set a separate user, lmsd runs as root, allowing the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
This issue was fixed in commit 89dd3f7. The lmsd component was removed. For existing installations that use lmsd, the recommended solution is to disable and remove this component.

NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to inject raw SQL by persisting a crafted formula parsed_tree reused without revalidation. Attackers can bypass the SQLite metadata path guard with an alias to plant the tree, escalating to super administrator or executing OS commands on external PostgreSQL hosts.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 persists a table block's caption attribute into IAL properties without HTML sanitization, causing stored cross-site scripting upon import or sync. Attackers can inject an entity-encoded caption with an onerror handler that executes in the Electron client's nodeIntegration context to achieve remote code execution.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-44670, because renderAVAttribute() inserts an Attribute View name unescaped into the database row attribute panel header. Attackers who can persist the name, such as via the setAttrViewName action, can inject an onerror handler that runs OS commands through Node.js when a desktop user opens the panel.

SiYuan from 3.3.0 before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject HTML via unescaped checkbox column names in Gallery and Kanban AttributeView renderers. Attackers can share a crafted .sy.zip document whose rendering in the Electron desktop client with nodeIntegration enabled executes Node.js and host OS commands.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in genAVValueHTML() that allows attackers who can store Attribute View asset values to inject script through an unescaped image src attribute. Attackers can store an image URL containing a double quote and onerror handler that executes OS commands via Node.js in the desktop app when victims open the bound note or row attribute panel.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to execute script by storing malicious Attribute View column names rendered unescaped in col.ts. Attackers can inject HTML via addAttributeViewKey, .sy.zip import, or sync, and when a victim adds or duplicates the column, insertAdjacentHTML runs JavaScript with Node.js privileges for desktop code execution.

Missing authorization vulnerability in ASUS Control Center Datacenter and Control Center Enterprise allows remote authenticated users with a low-privileged Viewer role to change the password of an Administrator account, thereby obtaining administrative privileges, via a crafted password update request. 
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

Incorrect authorization in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote authenticated user with a low-privileged role to create an administrator account, resulting in administrative control of the management console and of the clients it manages.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

A vulnerability was identified in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. Impacted is the function exec of the file sslvpn/sslvpn_client.php of the component SSLVPN Client. Such manipulation of the argument img leads to os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability has been found in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. This issue affects the function send_email_authcode of the file user.cgi of the component Email Auth Code Sender. Such manipulation of the argument Username leads to os command injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

BeamNG.drive before 0.40.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability because JIT-compiled LuaJIT traces omit FFI array bounds checks, letting untrusted Lua escape the sandbox. Attackers supplying a malicious mod can JIT-compile an FFI store loop, write out of range using a tostring() address leak, re-enable ffi.load, and run commands as the game user.

Dagu 1.23.0 before 2.0.0 defaults auth.mode to none, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute OS commands through the /api/v2/dag-runs endpoint. Attackers can send a POST request with an inline spec defining steps containing arbitrary shell commands to achieve remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-03-11.

nginxWebUI 3.0.0 before 3.5.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach the /AdminPage/conf/runCmd endpoint by using a case-variant path that evades the case-sensitive /adminPage/ login filter. Attackers can pass OS commands through the cmd parameter, which are executed via /bin/sh with insufficient filtering of & and $() characters, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

MeterSphere versions 1.13.0 before 1.14.7 and 1.15.0 before 1.16.4 contain a pre-authentication code injection vulnerability due to the /plugin/** endpoints being exposed with anonymous access. Attackers can upload a malicious jar via POST /plugin/add and invoke it through POST /plugin/customMethod using the 'entry' and 'request' parameters, which are passed to Class.forName and method invocation for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

OpenSNS 3.2.1 contains an unauthenticated code injection vulnerability in the shareBox method of ShareController that allows attackers to invoke arbitrary model methods via the query parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests to /index.php?s=weibo/Share/shareBox abusing parse_str and ShareModel::getInfo to reach Schedule::runSchedule and execute code through assert. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

ThinkPHP 5.0.0 before 5.0.24 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands by setting _method=__construct in POST data to overwrite the Request filter property. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints reached via ?s=captcha or ?s=index/index/index with filter[]=system and server[REQUEST_METHOD] values to execute arbitrary system commands. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

ThinkPHP 2.0 through 2.2 and 3.0 Lite mode contains an eval injection vulnerability in the Dispatcher PATH_INFO parsing, which uses preg_replace with the /e modifier and a double-quoted replacement. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with a malicious 's' parameter containing PHP expressions to execute arbitrary code on the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

A vulnerability was identified in Netis WF2409E up to 20261026. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/skk_set.cgi of the component CGI Interface. The manipulation of the argument app/password/new_pwd_confirm/passwd_set/mode_name/wl_link leads to improper authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
Improper Access Control vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki - EditAccount Extension.
Copeland XWEB Pro contains a missing authentication vulnerability. Fixed in 1.16.1.

BusyBox through 1.38.0 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability in tftpd that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access files outside any intended directory when started without a DIR argument. Attackers can send RRQ or WRQ packets with file names beginning with '/' to read sensitive files like /etc/shadow or overwrite files, typically as root.

ntop n2n supernode 3.0 through 3.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to leak memory and execute code by sending an untrusted 16-bit auth token_size in REGISTER_SUPER_NAK datagrams. Attackers can register an edge in a chosen community, then send an oversized token_size to leak stack canaries and pointers, overwrite the return address, or crash the supernode.

Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by a reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious scripts into a web page, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must visit a maliciously crafted URL or interact with a compromised web page. Scope is changed.

An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command（'OS Command Injection') in the ASUS GPU Tweak III allows a remote user to execute arbitrary OS commands via a crafted request to an HTTP endpoint of the service.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS GPU Tweak III  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Config Search View Matches dialog, which renders configuration context via v-html without escaping. Attackers can place markup in device banners, interface descriptions, ACL remarks or SNMP locations to execute script in a user's session and read stored configurations containing secrets.
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Authentication Methods Portal Extension allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.

Missing authentication and authorization on an exposed interface allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to send arbitrary commands to the affected component, which can force a device reboot or let the attacker upload malicious firmware.

An attacker must control pagination data returned by an upstream API or service queried by an existing REST Collector. The Collector must use affected response-based pagination and process the crafted data during a job run. Successful exploitation executes code with the Worker service account's permissions.

N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

kev_info.vulnerabilityName: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
kev_info.shortDescription: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. This affects the function FUN_0040efb0 of the file gena.cgi of the component GENA Subscription Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument service results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a capability check bypass in its embedded JavaScript scripting engine, where the surrealdb.functions bridge calls the internal fnc::synchronous() and fnc::asynchronous() dispatchers without enforcing function capability checks. Authenticated users denied access to built-in functions in SurrealQL can execute them by calling them through surrealdb.functions from embedded JavaScript.

Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Documents & Files renameFile() action that allows authenticated users with folder upload rights to move files outside adm_my_files by supplying ../ sequences in adm_new_name. Attackers can relocate an uploaded SVG containing script to the web root, where it is served inline and executes stored cross-site scripting against administrators for account takeover.

U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows an unauthenticated user to inject unauthorized SQL commands that allow the attacker to gain root access and complete control over the database. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.12 and 4.6.02, an attacker with access to an SVG upload flow can hide a script element in an internal DTD entity. NukeViet\Files\Upload::check_svg_tmpfile() loads the document without entity expansion, leaving a DOMEntityReference, and sanitize_svg_dom() inspects only element nodes, while browsers expand the entity when the stored file is served as image/svg+xml. The SVG path also returned before verify_image() and preserved the original bytes, so the hidden script reached disk unchanged. Guest comment attachments make the upload unauthenticated only when a module's comment feature is open to the All or Guest group and allowattachcomm is enabled; module administrators can also use the file manager, allowing same-origin script execution in an administrator's session. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.12 and 4.6.02.

NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From the 3.x release line until 4.6.01, an unauthenticated visitor can submit a Contact module message containing an event-handler attribute prefixed by a slash. NukeViet\Core\Request::filterTags() tokenizes attributes using only ASCII spaces, so it sees /onerror and misses the ^on denylist, while the browser treats the slash as a separator and activates onerror. The message is stored and rendered without output encoding in the administration panel, which lacks a Content Security Policy, allowing same-origin JavaScript execution when an administrator opens the message. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

pip prior to v26.2.2 the certifi bundled with pip contains the compromised eMudhra certificates. 




Upgrading to a secure version of pip should be done either by first upgrading Python to a version that rejects the compromised intermediates (CVE-2026-115557) or use hash pinning with a known-secure version of pip. pip is not vulnerable when using a Python version that rejects the compromised certificates. See the references below for more information.

Netatalk is a Free and Open Source file server suite for Unix-like operating systems. From 2.0.0 until 4.5.1, the DHX2 and DHX2-PAM authentication state machine in etc/uams/uams_dhx2_pam.c permits logincont1 to be invoked again with the same FPLoginCont retID after it has released the global gcry_mpi_t Ra object. When DHX2 or DHX2PAM is enabled in the UAM list, a remote attacker without valid AFP credentials can repeat the first continuation step, causing gcry_mpi_powm to dereference the freed Ra value and gcry_mpi_release to free it again in a privileged afpd worker. The demonstrated result is a repeatable pre-authentication worker crash, and the use-after-free and double-free provide a plausible allocator exploitation primitive although code execution was not demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.1.

A Path Traversal vulnerability in workspace directory handling and Git integration in Google Cloud Dataform, BigQuery Studio and Colab Enterprise on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated remote attacker to read private files and create arbitrary files across tenant repositories using crafted workspace operations and Git integration requests.


This vulnerability was patched on 10 October 2026, and no customer action is needed.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Tribulant Software Newsletters newsletters-lite allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Newsletters: from n/a through 4.18.2.

A stack-based buffer overflow in an unauthenticated CGI handler of the
Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controller allows remote attackers to send specially
crafted HTTP/S POST requests, leading to memory corruption, webserver restart
and hypothetically potential arbitrary code execution with webserver privileges.
Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. Affected is the function genacgi_main of the file gena.cgi of the component GENA Handler. Such manipulation leads to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

A missing authentication vulnerability in WatchGuard Dimension's log collection service allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements and ultimately execute arbitrary code as the Dimension WebUI process user by sending specially crafted network requests.

WatchGuard Dimension records unredacted session identifiers for logged-in users in its web UI diagnostic log. A low-privileged Dimension Administrator can retrieve this log and extract a Super Administrator's session token while that administrator is logged in, enabling account takeover.

This vulnerability is a secondary unmitigated attack path for CVE-2026-78174.

WatchGuard Dimension returns unredacted session identifiers for logged-in users in a management API response. A low-privileged Dimension Administrator can retrieve the active session IDs of other administrators, including Super Administrators, while they are logged in, enabling account takeover.

Sprout Track is a self-hosted baby tracking application. Prior to 1.3.5, Sprout Track uses a publicly known hardcoded signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset, and standard setup does not generate a unique secret. On a network-reachable affected deployment, an unauthenticated attacker can sign JWTs with arbitrary claims, including system-administrator claims, to access administrative functionality and read or modify family, child activity, account, and email data. Deployments with a strong unique JWT_SECRET are not affected. Managed and hosted instances were reported remediated. This issue is fixed in version 1.3.5.

The Comelit 1456B Multi-User Gateway, in firmware versions up to and including 2.10.0, is configured with static default passwords for multiple privileged roles. None of these passwords are required to be changed during initial configuration, and they remain at their default values unless the administrator changes them manually. An attacker with network access to the device can authenticate using these default credentials and gain administrative control.

Deserialization of untrusted data in double-submit cookie vs. form field validation in Idunno.AntiCsrf versions through 0.9.1 Beta on ASP.NET allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code via object injection

kev_info.vulnerabilityName: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
kev_info.shortDescription: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.description: Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI header parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A header parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI query parameter name verbatim as an array key in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A query parameter name containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, the Jane open-api-3 generator emits an OpenAPI parameter description verbatim in generated Client/Endpoint method docblocks. A parameter description containing a PHPDoc closing delimiter can terminate the comment early and place attacker-controlled PHP in class-body position, including an __construct method that runs when the generated Client is instantiated. Exploitation requires generating a client from an attacker-influenced OpenAPI document and then using the generated SDK, and can execute arbitrary PHP with the consuming application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import, Docker support, and collection statistics. Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/database/import handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/database.py accepts a ZIP archive and moves an included database file to DATABASE_PATH while also replacing IMAGE_PATH content. An attacker can supply a database containing an attacker-controlled users table and administrative account, then authenticate as that account; invalid replacement data can also destroy application data or availability. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.2.

MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import, Docker support, and collection statistics. Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/images/manga/save handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/image.py accepts a client-controlled filename and joins it to IMAGE_SAVE_PATH without confining the result. Traversal sequences can escape the image directory and overwrite process-writable files, including DATABASE_PATH for the live SQLite database, while the client-supplied image content type does not validate the uploaded bytes. An attacker can replace the database to plant an administrative user and can overwrite other writable files, causing full application compromise and availability loss. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.2.

Todoist MCP Server provides tools that allow AI agents to access and modify a Todoist account. Prior to 10.3.3, the optional todoist-mcp-http server accepts browser-origin requests to POST /mcp without validating the Host and Origin headers or authenticating the browser caller. A malicious website can use DNS rebinding to reach the loopback listener and invoke MCP tools through StreamableHTTPServerTransport, which uses the server-held Todoist API key. This exposes Todoist account data and permits operations such as task creation, updates, completion, and deletion. The stdio transport is not browser-reachable and is not affected by this attack path. This issue is fixed in version 10.3.3.

Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through the default project event stream and skips authorization when cancelling operations without associated permissions. Restricted clients can subscribe to operation events to capture certificate tokens and enroll unrestricted certificates, gaining full server access, or cancel token operations by UUID.

pnpm exe before 10.34.8 embeds an outdated Node.js runtime that still trusts compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates during registry TLS connections. Network attackers holding a recovered intermediate key can intercept standalone pnpm registry fetches and serve forged package metadata or tarballs.

All versions of LaraDashboard contain an authentication bypass in SocialAuthService::findOrCreateUser(), which links a social login to an existing account by email without checking that the OAuth provider verified that email. Unauthenticated attackers using an OAuth/OIDC provider that asserts a victim's email can log in as any user, including Superadmin, and keep persistent access through a linked social_accounts entry.

Hardcoded credentials in the executable file. These can be extracted using the “Strings.exe” tool and could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the database and SMTP server. 
winSAT.exe
Hardcoded credentials in the executable file. These can be extracted using the “Strings.exe” tool and could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the database and SMTP server. winCRM.exe

ArangoDB before 3.12.11 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a parser differential between the raw path authentication gate and the URL-decoded dispatch logic. Attackers can send requests with a %5f-encoded leading underscore to endpoints like /_db/_system/%5fapi/simple/first-example to reach /_api/* actions as superuser without authentication. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-09-16.

iDocView before 13.10.1_20231115 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the /html/2word endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files by supplying a malicious url parameter. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the url parameter to download linked resources with an unsanitized path and unblocked .jsp extension, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-22.

Weaver E-cology 9.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in /page/exportImport/uploadOperation.jsp that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary JSP files. Attackers can send a crafted multipart POST request with a JSP webshell written to /page/exportImport/fileTransfer/ to achieve remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.

Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the catchimage action of /ueditor/net/controller.ashx that only validates the Content-Type header. Unauthenticated attackers can supply a source[] URL like x.jpg?.aspx to retain a malicious extension and write an executable .aspx file for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig injection vulnerability that allows media-only accounts and anonymous uploaders to execute Twig by placing delimiters in image titles, alt text, class, id, or file names. Attackers can combine injected Twig with the autoescape tag to serve script to every page visitor, including super admins, or expose unpublished page content.

Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to overwrite pages their per-page permissions deny by abusing FolderStorage key delimiter collisions and PageStorage folder reconstruction. Attackers can rename a folder like locked*** or save from a page with an unusual prefix width through a front-end Flex pages form, replacing protected content and permissions to access the protected subtree.

NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows OAuth token holders to act as full sessions because OAuth access tokens are signed with the instance JWT secret. Attackers can present a narrowly scoped OAuth token to the session strategy, short-lived-token exchange, or NocoSocket handshake to gain the granting user's full privileges.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Editor users to execute script by injecting markup into fields rendered through URL() formulas. The canvas grid renderer assigns unsanitized formula output to innerHTML, letting attackers steal session tokens from localStorage and take over accounts of users viewing the table.

NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated Creators to access another tenant's external database by reusing a victim source id when adding a source. Because NcConnectionMgrv2 caches connections by bare source id, attackers can reflect the victim's cached database schema and read, update, and insert records through their own base models.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 uses an incomplete deny-list in IsSensitivePath that omits shell-initialization files such as .zshenv and .bash_profile, as well as ~/.local. Authenticated administrators can call /api/file/copyFile with an absolute destination outside the workspace to write payloads there, which execute as the user on the next shell or login.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in ImageTransforms::normalizeTransform() that allows attackers to instantiate arbitrary classes by supplying class:null with a __class key. Attackers can reach the method through Craft Commerce's payments/pay redirect template calling customer.photo.getUrl() with a crafted transform to instantiate classes like yii\rbac\PhpManager and execute PHP.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains an incomplete blocklist fix that allows attackers who can author entry type title formats to write arbitrary files using ZipArchive or XMLWriter classes. Attackers can abuse the non-sandboxed renderObjectTemplate() renderer to write attacker-controlled content into the web docroot, achieving remote code execution.

WWBN AVideo through c3edcc274c389816d434acadac07ee78eaf330c1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because the default node socket server relays autoEvalCodeOnHTML without the PHP-only filter. Unauthenticated attackers can obtain an anonymous socket token and send a spoofed MSG_BATCH message to trigger client eval() in administrators' browsers for account takeover.

WWBN AVideo from 6.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with upload permission to inject script by submitting a javascript: scheme videoLink for embed videos. The unvalidated URL is rendered into an iframe src in videoEmbeded.php and PlayerSkins.php, executing for viewers including administrators and enabling creation of new administrator accounts.

Rclone from 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in serve sftp --auth-proxy because the generateCacheKey cache key omits the authentication method. Attackers knowing a victim's base64 public key can submit it as a password from the same client IP to reuse the cached entry and gain read-write VFS access.

Use-after-free in magic method backtraces can lead to remote code execution.

When collecting the arguments of a method call handled by __call() or __callStatic() for a backtrace, PHP can read stale values that may refer to freed memory. If a fatal error such as exceeding memory_limit occurs while an application enters such a call, with fatal_error_backtraces enabled (the default) and zend.exception_ignore_args disabled, a remote attacker who controls enough request data to influence memory allocation may cause memory corruption, crash the PHP worker or, with knowledge of memory addresses, execute arbitrary code. php.ini-production enables zend.exception_ignore_args, which prevents this.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body.

PHP does not discard the unread part of an HTTP request body at request shutdown when the application has opened php://input without reading it to the end. When the front end reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache (for example nginx with fastcgi_keep_conn on, or Apache mod_proxy_fcgi with enablereuse=on), PHP-FPM can parse the leftover bytes as a new FastCGI request. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use a single crafted multipart/form-data request to forge a backend request with chosen parameters such as SCRIPT_FILENAME, REMOTE_ADDR and PHP_ADMIN_VALUE, which can lead to execution of attacker-controlled PHP code. With LSAPI, subsequent requests on the connection can be disrupted.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Session serializer mismatch can lead to remote code execution.

Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. A remote attacker able to submit a multipart upload can inject objects, which may lead to code execution when the reading application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to session corruption or denial of service.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a backend, a specially crafted request can result in use-after-free in the worker process, if this process is running low on worker_connections. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.




Impact:



This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or may allow a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. When NGINX processes undisclosed traffic, the flow control window can exceed the allowed threshold, potentially resulting in a heap buffer overflow typically followed by an NGINX worker segmentation fault. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code remotely. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki - Echo Extension. This vulnerability is associated with program files includes/Model/Event.php. This issue affects MediaWiki - Echo Extension: from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, 1.47.

OpenResty stream-lua-nginx-module before 0.0.20rc4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote peers to trigger access to freed memory when a receiveuntil() pattern iterator is garbage-collected while still referenced by the socket. Attackers can interrupt or close the cosocket connection so later reads or socket closure use the stale pattern pointer, crashing or corrupting the nginx worker.

Joomla! Core - [20261117] - Core - Race condition in formatted text logger in Joomla 3.6.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - A race condition in the formatted text logger can recreate a log file without its protective header.

Joomla! Core - [20261112] - Core - Local file inclusion through language parameter in Joomla 1.6.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The language request parameter is not validated before it is used to build the path of included language files.

Joomla! Core - [20261111] - Core - Missing authentication in web installer in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - The web installer remains usable on an installed site as long as the installation folder exists, allowing unauthenticated users to rewrite the configuration.

fastcore through 2.2.44 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the fastcore.xtras.untar_dir() archive extraction helper that allows attackers who supply a crafted tar archive to write files outside the intended extraction directory. The internal _unpack() function passes the archive to shutil.unpack_archive() without a tar extraction filter, member path validation, or a containment check, so archive members with absolute paths or ../ traversal sequences are written to arbitrary locations writable by the application process when running on Python versions before 3.14. Applications that extract untrusted archives with untar_dir() can have application files, configuration, or importable code overwritten, which can lead to code execution, data modification, or denial of service.

Pangolin before 1.21.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in isPathAllowed() in server/lib/pathMatch.ts that splits paths on literal slashes without percent-decoding or resolving dot segments. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send paths with encoded slashes and dot segments to match public bypass rules while backends serve protected paths.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in woylie flop allows a remote attacker to execute code on the server via a crafted pagination cursor.

Flop.Cursor.decode/2 in lib/flop/cursor.ex decodes the after and before parameters with :erlang.binary_to_term/2 in :safe mode. Its check rejects functions, PIDs, ports and references, but it accepts maps, and therefore structs of any module. Flop passes the decoded values to Ecto as query parameters. A cursor value that nests an Ecto.Query.DynamicExpr struct with a DBConnection.Stream struct as its binding fails the Ecto cast. Ecto then inspects the value for the error message, the Inspect implementation enumerates the stream, and DBConnection calls the module, function and arguments in the :log option of the stream.

This issue affects flop: from 0.8.0 before 0.26.7, from 0.27.0 before 0.27.3, from 0.28.0 before 0.28.1, and from 0.29.0 before 0.29.2.

c-icap-server through 0.5.15 and 0.6.5 contains an out-of-bounds write in process_encapsulated() that allows unauthenticated attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending six Encapsulated entities. Attackers can send a single ICAP request whose sixth entity overwrites trash_entities[0], triggering use-after-free and double free in ci_request_destroy() during teardown.

FFmpeg 4.3 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in the dynaudnorm filter because cqueue_resize() miscalculates gain history queue element counts when gausssize changes at runtime. Attackers can send gausssize commands via asendcmd scripts or an unauthenticated azmq filter to corrupt heap memory, crashing the process or potentially executing code.

FFmpeg 4.4 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_deband.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a runtime coupling command. Attackers can send a 'deband coupling 1' command via sendcmd or an unauthenticated zmq filter, making chroma planes be processed at luma dimensions to crash the process or potentially execute code.

EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit a4161a9, contains a weak password recovery mechanism that allows attackers who obtain a still-valid password-reset link to take over accounts that use a local EUSurvey password. The /auth/reset/ flow checks only the age of a reset code and does not invalidate it after the password is changed, and issuing a newer link leaves earlier links active, so a used or superseded link remains valid for up to 24 hours from issuance and can be reused to set a new password, sign in as the affected user, and lock that user out.

BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v2/workflow/invoke and /api/v2/workflow/stop routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to run workflows as the administrator. Attackers knowing a workflow UUID can supply an override replacing a Code node's code parameter with Python passed to exec(), achieving remote code execution, or stop other users' workflow sessions.

Softaculous Virtualizor before 3.2.9 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in enduser/auth_callback.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication via OAuth-returned email addresses. Attackers can register an OAuth provider account with an email containing SQL syntax to complete social login as the administrator account.

Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a predictable session identifier vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack administrator sessions by deriving identifiers from process, time, ServerID, and client IP state. Attackers can enumerate candidate identifiers using the service_get_license.html endpoint as a validity oracle and replay live sessions to gain administrative control including the Lua console.

Interstellar before 6.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by enabling allow_loopback_ips and allow_private_ips in wisp-js at startup. Attackers can open a wisp WebSocket that bypasses the Express password middleware and create TCP streams to loopback, internal hosts, or cloud metadata services.

simple-git before 4.1.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the allowUnsafePack guard by supplying the --exec option to non-push git operations. Attackers who influence arguments passed to listRemote() or raw() can inject --exec for ls-remote, archive, fetch-pack or send-pack to execute commands on the host.

binary-parser before 2.3.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling parser definitions to inject JavaScript through string-typed options passed unvalidated by Context.generateOption(). Attackers can supply crafted length, lengthInBytes, key, tag, offset, or namely() alias values to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Node.js process when the parser is compiled.

OpenRemote core before 1.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in UserAssetProvisioningMQTTHandler that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned devices without proof of private key possession. Attackers can publish a known device's public certificate to the provisioning request topic, authenticating their anonymous MQTT connection as the device's service account to read and modify assets.

Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows role administrators to inject JavaScript by placing quote-breaking payloads in role names rendered unencoded in the data-message attribute in modules/profile/roles_functions.php. Attackers can execute scripts when a full administrator views an affected profile page, stealing the CSRF token to assign themselves the Administrator role.

Poste.io is vulnerable to remote code execution in DMARC report processing. Email sent to dmarc-reports@<domain> is saved without sender verification. Script that runs as root unpacks the attachments using unsafe shell commands, allowing command injection through crafted attachments (e.g. file names or archive contents). A remote unauthenticated attacker who can send an email to the server's port 25 can execute arbitrary commands as root within the Poste.io container.


This issue was fixed in version 2.5.22.

In Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Runtime versions 4.2.4 and prior, a race condition allows multiple concurrent requests to pass the existence check before any user is committed, resulting in several unauthenticated admin accounts being created.

Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a file mask bypass vulnerability allowing attackers to upload restricted files via an embedded NUL byte in Upload Link filenames. Attackers can plant a Lua session file with a chosen UID and send a matching UID cookie to execute operating system commands as the service account.

Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in frontend data view filters in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Sorting, location radius and published filters of the frontend data view were not properly sanitized, allowing SQL injection, partly without authentication.

Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in reload task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - Input placeholders in SQL field statements were inserted without quoting in the public reload task, allowing unauthenticated SQL injection in read queries.

Timezone cache use-after-free can lead to remote code execution.

In non-thread-safe builds, a diagnostic written to a file-based error_log during module startup, for example for an invalid date.timezone value or a session configuration warning, causes the timezone cache to be allocated in startup memory that is freed while a reference to it is kept. A diagnostic raised early in the first request of a worker, such as the max_input_vars warning, then accesses the freed cache. On such a deployment an unauthenticated remote attacker can crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers with a crafted request. Arbitrary code execution may be possible and has been demonstrated with known memory addresses.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Use-after-free after interrupted session shutdown.

The session extension records the filename of the executing script when a session starts. If a fatal error occurs in an application callback while the session variables are destroyed at shutdown, such as stream_close() of a user-defined stream wrapper, the pointer is retained after the request memory is freed, and a later request handled by the same worker can free the stale string. An attacker who can trigger such a failing cleanup may crash the worker or corrupt memory; code execution has not been demonstrated. This requires the filename to be allocated in request memory, for example when the script is not cached by OPcache.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Use-after-free via repopulation of last_fatal_error_backtrace global after shutdown.

A fatal error raised while modified INI settings are restored during request shutdown can repopulate the stored fatal error backtrace after the executor has been cleaned up. The request memory is then freed, and a diagnostic emitted before executor initialization in a later request handled by the same PHP-FPM or mod_php worker can access the stale backtrace. The shutdown error requires per-path configuration of max_memory_limit, or of zlib.output_compression together with output_handler (which .user.ini can also set). The early diagnostic requires Apache per-directory configuration or, for PHP-FPM, a PHP_VALUE or PHP_ADMIN_VALUE parameter sent by the front end. This can cause memory corruption and worker crashes, and may allow remote code execution.

This issue affects PHP versions 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Partially overwritten session files can lead to remote code execution.

The files session save handler, which is the default, writes updated session data into the existing session file without first clearing it. If a write is interrupted, the file can contain the beginning of the new session followed by the end of the old one, and bytes of an ordinary string can later be unserialized as objects. An attacker who can influence the session data, for example through session upload progress, and interrupt a write at a suitable point may inject objects, which can lead to code execution when the application contains a suitable gadget chain. Session data can also be corrupted.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

The web installer of JTL-Shop executes its
state-changing installation tasks without checking whether the shop is already
installed, and was not removed or locked after the installation. An unauthenticated
remote attacker who can reach the installer directory can supply their own
database credentials, create administrator and synchronisation accounts and
overwrite the shop configuration. This can lead to a full takeover of
the shop, including code execution on the server.

Incus before 7.6.0 creates the NBD servers used for virtual machine migration and disk export on abstract unix sockets, which have no permission checks and whose names are visible in /proc/net/unix. A local unprivileged user can connect while an operation runs to read or modify the VM disk, gaining code execution in the guest on a migration's receiving side.

This issue occurs when NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a proxy, the proxied server name includes variables, and a Server Side Includes (SSI) or mirror directive sends a subrequest to a location that resolves the same server name. Under these conditions, a specially crafted HTTP request may cause a use-after-free condition in a worker process. An attacker may also be able to execute code if Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) is disabled or the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact: 
An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or perform remote code execution (RCE)



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Description:
This issue affects NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/3. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can cause a use-after-free condition in the NGINX worker process, leading to a restart. Exploitation also depends on conditions beyond the attacker’s control. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or to possibly trigger a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Description: 
BIG-IP iControl REST tokens may not expire as expected in all scenarios.   

Impact: 
An attacker who has obtained a token may be able to extend its expiry lifetime unless the token owner deletes it. There is no data plane exposure; this is a control plane issue only.

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a mail proxy, undisclosed traffic can cause a use-after-free in an nginx worker process. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
A remote unauthenticated attacker may crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, disrupting service. Remote code execution is a potential impact. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Lucee Server versions 5.0.0.0 before 5.3.4.46 contain an insecure default configuration that allows unauthenticated attackers to set the initial admin password via the first-run form on /lucee/admin/web.cfm and /lucee/admin/server.cfm. Attackers can access the 'New Password' set-password form before any password is configured to seize administrative control of the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-24.

CAST Imaging is vulnerable to authentication bypass in the TenantFilter class. The TenantFilter processes the X-ISSUER-LOCATION HTTP header and dynamically registers an OpenID Connect issuer based on its value. An unauthenticated remote attacker can register a malicious identity provider, create users matching existing administrative usernames, and obtain valid JWTs which will be accepted by the application. This results in complete authentication bypass and privilege escalation to administrative access.




The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to create super-admin accounts because UserCollection::count() uses an unescaped glob() pattern. On installs whose path contains brackets or a backslash, the account count returns zero, so attackers can send requests to POST /api/v1/auth/setup or the classic admin registration form to create or overwrite administrator accounts.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki - EmailAuth Extension. This vulnerability is associated with program files includes/EmailAuthSecondaryAuthenticationProvider.php. This issue affects MediaWiki - EmailAuth Extension: 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, 1.47.

Vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki - OATHAuth Extension. This vulnerability is associated with program files src/Key/WebAuthnKey.php. This issue affects MediaWiki - OATHAuth Extension: from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, 1.47.

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.10.0, a user can add a version under another user's workflow ID and take over its Marketplace listing. An attacker with an account and the target's workflow ID can replace the creator's pending Marketplace submission with their own, so that approval installs the attacker's workflow under the creator's listing. Without reviewer involvement, the attacker can also stop the owner from saving new versions and break runs that name no version. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability that could result in a Security feature bypass. A low-privileged attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized read and limited write access. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to root on the appliance.
